definition.simple: The person who sells an option. They receive the premium and take on the duty to buy or sell if assigned.
definition.balanced: The premium is the most a writer can make. A writer of an [[uncovered-option|uncovered]] call has no fixed limit on loss; a writer of a put can lose up to (strike − premium) × units if the price falls to zero. Brokers usually require approval and [[margin]] before you can write options.
